name: Real Estate Investor System in Excel – Know Your Return Before You Buy
html:
Know what a deal really returns before you offer, which property quietly loses money and when a balloon or rehab bill will drain your cash. This is a complete back office for an individual investor or small investment company in Excel: eight connected workbooks that already work with sample data, so you see every alert and dashboard before you type your first property.

Built for investors with about 8 to 20 properties – single-family rentals, small multi-unit buildings and a few renovate-and-resell projects – a part-time assistant and outside contacts: agents, brokers, contractors, a property manager, an accountant.

What you get:

  • 8 connected workbooks: deal analysis and pipeline; financing, loans and refinance; renovation budgets and contractor draws; rent roll, tenants and leases; maintenance, capex and insurance; property performance against underwriting; net worth, taxes and exit planning; cash flow, reserves and growth
  • 552 ready pages: dashboards, calculators, printable forms and checklists, and ready WhatsApp messages
  • 15 languages, each as a blank template, with filled sample-data copies in English
  • Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, no macros, no subscription

How it works: 1) open the workbook in your language, 2) type your deals, loans, rents and costs in the yellow cells, 3) cash flow, cap rate, maximum offer, arrears, balloon countdown, net worth and cash forecast update by themselves. One payment, instant download.

What it does for you

  • Know the cash flow, cash-on-cash return and cap rate of a deal before you offer
  • See the maximum offer price that still reaches your return
  • See every deal and offer in one pipeline and never let a good one go cold
  • Compare loan quotes and see the true cost of a private lender
  • Never be surprised by a balloon date and plan the payoff in time
  • Know if a refinance pays back its costs and how much cash it frees
  • Track every rehab budget and release contractor draws with retainage
  • Spot late rent, vacancies and expiring leases before they cost you
  • Fix, repair or replace with a capex plan and a reserve for every property
  • Compare real results with your purchase underwriting and spot losing properties
  • See your equity and net worth, with depreciation and gain records for your adviser
  • Forecast cash 13 weeks ahead and know the safe owner draw

Do I need special software?
No. The files are standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, which is free.

Does it fit a small portfolio and a larger one?
Yes. It is built for investors with about 8 to 20 properties, from one owner with a part-time assistant to a small company. The sample data shows 14 rental properties with 25 units, 2 renovation projects, 17 loans and about 250 analysed deals.

Can I replace the sample data with my own?
Yes. Every workbook comes in 15 languages as a blank template, plus filled sample-data copies in English, so you can explore first and start clean when you are ready. Each fact is typed once and every dashboard reads it from there.

Can I use my own currency, rates and targets?
Yes. Currency, target return, loan terms, vacancy allowance, reserve months, cash floor and growth targets are on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes. Tax pages are generic records, so confirm them with your tax adviser. This is a tool for your own analysis, not financial advice.

Where do I start?
Start with Part 1 to analyse your next deal, or with the part that hurts most today, such as rent roll or loans. Each workbook works alone and links to the others as you fill it.

Are there macros or a subscription, and how do I receive it?
No macros and no subscription. You pay once and download a ZIP at once with every workbook in all 15 languages.
seo: Run your rental portfolio from 8 connected Excel workbooks: deal analysis, loans, rehab, rent roll, maintenance, results, net worth and cash flow. 15 languages.
